zh.title: 國泰80週年「生菜葉三文治」A350今晨飛抵桃園　航迷可前往拍攝B-LRJ
zh.summary: 國泰航空80週年復古塗裝A350-900 B-LRJ於10月5日上午執飛CX422由香港飛往桃園，為臺灣航空迷近期拍攝這架「生菜葉三文治」特殊塗裝客機的機會之一。
body: 國泰航空（Cathay Pacific）80週年復古塗裝Airbus A350-900客機B-LRJ於今（5）日上午執飛CX422航班，由香港國際機場（HKG）前往臺灣桃園國際機場（TPE）。該班機原訂臺北時間上午7時10分起飛、上午8時55分抵達桃園，為近期航空攝影愛好者可在臺灣拍攝這架特殊塗裝客機的機會之一。
Flightradar24最新航機紀錄顯示，此次CX422確由註冊編號B-LRJ執飛，機型為Airbus A350-941，ICAO機型代碼A359。航機約於上午7時43分自香港起飛，較原訂時間稍晚；系統一度顯示預估約上午9時09分抵達桃園，因此實際落地時間仍可能因航路、流量與航管安排有所變動。
B-LRJ是國泰航空為慶祝成立80週年推出的特別塗裝客機之一，機身重新採用經典綠白條紋「生菜葉三文治」（lettuce leaf sandwich）設計，並加入大型「80」週年識別。國泰航空指出，這套塗裝曾在1970年代至1990年代初期廣泛出現在旗下機隊，也是航空迷相當熟悉的歷史塗裝之一。
這架A350-900於2026年1月完成80週年特別塗裝後投入正常商業營運，並未固定執飛特定航線，而是隨國泰航空機隊調度前往不同國際航點。國泰航空過去也曾特別安排B-LRJ前往新加坡樟宜機場及河內內排國際機場展示80週年塗裝，因此每次出現在特定市場時，往往受到當地航空迷關注。
國泰航空官方將這款復古設計稱為「生菜葉三文治」塗裝，在香港航空迷之間亦常以「大柴」稱呼。除了B-LRJ外，國泰貨運亦以Boeing 747-8F重新呈現相同概念的80週年復古塗裝，以呼應國泰自1946年創立以來的客運與貨運發展歷史。
由於CX422今日安排B-LRJ執飛，計畫前往桃園機場周邊拍攝的航空迷，可依當日上午實際航班動態及桃園機場跑道使用方向選擇適合位置；航機派遣、抵達時間及使用跑道仍可能臨時變更，拍攝前應以最新航班追蹤及機場運作資訊為準。

en.title: Cathay's 80th Anniversary 'Lettuce Leaf Sandwich' A350 Arrives in Taoyuan, Offering Spotters a Chance to Photograph B-LRJ
en.summary: Cathay Pacific's 80th anniversary retro-livery Airbus A350-900 B-LRJ operated flight CX422 from Hong Kong to Taoyuan on October 5, giving aviation photographers in Taiwan another chance to capture the special aircraft.
body: Cathay Pacific's 80th anniversary retro-livery Airbus A350-900 B-LRJ operated flight CX422 from Hong Kong International Airport (HKG) to Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport (TPE) on the morning of October 5. The flight was originally scheduled to depart at 7:10 a.m. Taipei time and arrive at Taoyuan at 8:55 a.m., providing aviation photographers in Taiwan with another opportunity to capture the special-livery aircraft.

The latest Flightradar24 aircraft records show that CX422 was indeed operated by B-LRJ, an Airbus A350-941 with ICAO type code A359. The aircraft departed Hong Kong at about 7:43 a.m., somewhat later than scheduled, while the system at one point showed an estimated arrival at Taoyuan of around 9:09 a.m. Actual landing time could still vary depending on routing, traffic and air traffic control arrangements.

B-LRJ is one of Cathay Pacific's special-livery aircraft introduced to celebrate the airline's 80th anniversary. Its fuselage revives the classic green-and-white striped 'lettuce leaf sandwich' design and adds a prominent '80' anniversary marking. Cathay Pacific has said the livery was widely used across its fleet from the 1970s to the early 1990s and remains a familiar historic design among aviation enthusiasts.

The A350-900 entered regular commercial service after receiving the 80th anniversary livery in January 2026. It is not assigned to a fixed route and instead operates to different international destinations according to Cathay Pacific's fleet scheduling. Cathay has previously arranged for B-LRJ to visit Singapore Changi Airport and Hanoi Noi Bai International Airport to showcase the anniversary livery, with each appearance drawing attention from local aviation enthusiasts.

Cathay Pacific officially refers to the retro design as the 'lettuce leaf sandwich' livery, while some Hong Kong aviation enthusiasts also call it 'Dai Chai.' In addition to B-LRJ, Cathay Cargo has recreated the same 80th anniversary retro concept on a Boeing 747-8F, reflecting the airline group's passenger and cargo history since its founding in 1946.

With B-LRJ assigned to CX422 today, aviation enthusiasts planning to photograph the aircraft around Taoyuan Airport can choose locations based on the morning's actual flight status and runway configuration. Aircraft assignment, arrival time and runway use can still change at short notice, so spotters should check the latest flight-tracking and airport operational information before heading out.
